title: News Reflection: El Niño wisdom from Marcos and Duterte
summary: He says be ready with pails; she says better accept what's up ahead

blocks.text: He says be ready with pails; she says better accept what's up ahead

The Uniteam may have long parted ways, but each severed half has droplets of wisdom to share on how Filipinos may navigate an impending bout of Super El Niño. President Bongbong Marcos preaches the manifold uses of pails, while Vice President Sara Duterte teaches the art of acceptance.
Paterno Esmaquel II has this week’s News Reflection. – Rappler.com
